2026-10-23-137.title: See who leads each project on the Schedule
2026-10-23-137.body: The Schedule of the Dashboard now shows the leader of each project on its row. To see only the projects of one leader, press Filter and pick the leader.

2026-10-23-136.title: Needs first on the to-dos you made
2026-10-23-136.body: You made a to-do, and your role may change its details. The list "Needs first" now shows on it. Before, it showed only when your role could also give to-dos to other people.

2026-10-23-135.title: The Inbox filters fit one row in Arabic
2026-10-23-135.body: On a phone in Arabic, the fourth Inbox filter went to a second row. The Arabic name of the To-dos filter is now shorter, so all four filters fit in one row.

2026-10-23-131.title: Reset links are harder to guess
2026-10-23-131.body: The code inside each "Forgot your password?" link and each invitation link now has 10 digits, not 6. A guess now has almost no chance. Your links work as before.

2026-10-23-132.title: A stricter check of report ids
2026-10-23-132.body: Madar now refuses an id that names no real request or bug report, before it changes anything. A security scan found this gap.

2026-10-23-133.title: Madar refuses an AI app that hides an address
2026-10-23-133.body: When you connect an AI app, Madar now checks every address that the app can send you back to. If the app hides an address on another site, Madar refuses it. Known AI apps such as Claude and ChatGPT connect as before.

2026-10-23-134.title: A deleted project's History stays with its team
2026-10-23-134.body: If a role cannot see every project, its people now read the History of a deleted project only when they led it, were on its team, or were chosen to see it. Before, they could read the History of any deleted project that was not hidden.

2026-10-23-127.title: See a PDF before you download it
2026-10-23-127.body: Press a PDF in a chat or a comment. It opens a preview. Press "Download" inside it to save the file.

2026-10-23-126.title: Insert a project file into a chat
2026-10-23-126.body: Press the clip in a chat and choose "Insert from a project". Pick files or folders. Madar sends them with no new upload and no new storage. The list shows only the projects that all the people of the chat are on.

2026-10-23-125.title: Bigger files in a project
2026-10-23-125.body: You can now upload files up to 500 MB in a project. Before, the limit was 250 MB. A chat keeps the limit of 250 MB.

2026-10-23-123.title: No push about a project you cannot see
2026-10-23-123.body: Madar now sends you no push about a project you can no longer see. Before, a push that was already on its way could still arrive. It said "You have something new in Madar."

2026-10-23-122.title: The week names in the Tracker history stay right
2026-10-23-122.body: The Tracker history now changes its week names, such as "This week" and "Last week", on time. This also works when a project stays open on your screen into a new week.

2026-10-23-121.title: A correct note when you deactivate a leader
2026-10-23-121.body: When you deactivate a person who leads projects, the warning lists those projects. If your role may change the leader of any project, you no longer read "An Admin changes the leader."

2026-10-23-120.title: Your AI assistant reads the chats too
2026-10-23-120.body: When you ask your AI assistant about a project or a to-do, it now also reads the project chat, the posts and the to-do thread. It tells you in which chat it found the answer. Start a new chat with your assistant to get this.

2026-10-23-119.title: More statuses for requests and bugs
2026-10-23-119.body: The Admin can now set a request or a bug report to In review, In progress, Done or Rejected. When your report is rejected, you get a notice with the reason.

2026-10-23-117.title: Your AI assistant can upload files
2026-10-23-117.body: Your AI assistant can now upload a file to a project, a to-do or a meeting. The file can be up to 10 MB. It can also send a report with up to 3 pictures.

2026-10-23-115.title: Your AI assistant does more at once
2026-10-23-115.body: Your AI assistant can now rename and add stages, change many to-dos in one step, and read long lists page by page.

2026-10-23-113.title: Link a payment to its Daftra invoice
2026-10-23-113.body: Madar now shows the Daftra invoice of a payment. Open the payment and link the invoice that Madar suggests. When Daftra says the invoice is paid, Madar sets the payment to Received. Madar only reads Daftra. It never changes anything there.

2026-10-23-107.title: Fixes for to-dos and Home
2026-10-23-107.body: The to-do panel keeps what you type: a save of the title no longer clears the description that you write, and the reverse. On Home, a drag keeps a to-do in its group, past due or due today. On a computer, Meetings today drops a meeting when it ends.

2026-10-23-106.title: Morning summary on office days
2026-10-23-106.body: The morning summary email now comes only on the office work days, also when you set more days for your notifications. Your pushes keep your own days.

2026-10-23-105.title: Chat in Focus mode
2026-10-23-105.body: In Focus mode, press "Project chat" to open a sidebar beside the timer. At its top, switch between the project chat and the thread of the to-do. Madar keeps your choice on this device. On a phone the chat opens as a full page.

2026-10-23-104.title: Open space: show more or less
2026-10-23-104.body: The Open space map now fits your screen and grows on a big one. Use "Show more" and "Show less" to open the map one level at a time: sub-companies, projects, stages, to-dos with deadlines, and checklists.

2026-10-23-103.title: Undo stays longer
2026-10-23-103.body: The Undo button now stays 8 seconds. Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on a Mac) takes back the last change while the Undo button shows, also with an Arabic keyboard. On a phone, a swipe on a notice shows Undo too.

2026-10-23-102.title: Madar records errors and usage
2026-10-23-102.body: Madar now records errors and how people use it, so we fix problems faster. It never records what you type, chat messages or amounts. Details in Settings.

2026-10-23-101.title: Create a project with your AI assistant
2026-10-23-101.body: Your AI assistant can now create a project and a client for you. Give it the name, the client, the sub-company, the leader and the team. The leader and the team get a notice. A new project has no Undo, so check the details first. The Admin gives this to a role with the switch "AI creates projects and clients".

2026-10-23-100.title: Unread messages outside your filter
2026-10-23-100.body: When the Inbox shows one kind of chat, a line under the list now says how many unread messages are in the other chats. Press "Show all" to see them.

2026-10-23-99.title: Madar on the phone: four tabs
2026-10-23-99.body: On a phone, Madar now has four tabs at the bottom: Today (the sun), Inbox (the tray), Work (the briefcase) and Me (the person). Chats and notifications share the Inbox. To-dos, meetings and projects share Work. Your settings are in Me.

2026-10-23-98.title: Quiet times in order
2026-10-23-98.body: In Settings, the two times now read like the quiet line: "Quiet from" the end of your work, "Until" its start.

2026-10-23-97.title: Download many files at once
2026-10-23-97.body: Under a chat message or a comment with two files or more, press Download all. On the Files tab, press it for a stage or for the whole project. You get one ZIP file.

2026-10-23-96.title: When Madar notifies you, in plain words
2026-10-23-96.body: Settings now names the hours when Madar notifies you, and one line tells you when it stays quiet. A day the office keeps on shows a small lock. The office hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

2026-10-23-95.title: A role can see only its own projects
2026-10-23-95.body: Open Admin, then Roles. Turn off See every project for a role. The people of that role then see only the projects where they work.

2026-10-23-94.title: Hide a project from the office
2026-10-23-94.body: Open the Team tab of a project. Choose who sees it: everyone in the office, or only the team and the people that you choose. A hidden project shows a small lock.

2026-10-23-93.title: Internal projects
2026-10-23-93.body: Make a project for your own office work, like a portfolio. Choose Internal project when you make a new project. It has no client, code, place or payments. Only the team sees it.

2026-10-23-92.title: Photos start to upload sooner
2026-10-23-92.body: A big photo from your phone now starts to upload sooner, and the phone uses less memory while it gets ready.

2026-10-23-91.title: Your to-dos on a board
2026-10-23-91.body: See your to-dos on a board: To do, In progress, In review and Done. Press View on the Tasks screen and pick Board. Done shows the to-dos that you finished in the last 7 days.

2026-10-23-87.title: Zoom into a picture
2026-10-23-87.body: Open a picture in a chat or a comment, then zoom. On a phone, pinch with two fingers, or tap twice. On a computer, use the mouse wheel, click the picture, or press + and -. Press 0 to go back to the full picture.

2026-10-23-86.title: Put the checklist in your own order
2026-10-23-86.body: Drag the grip at the end of a checklist item to move it. Everyone who opens the to-do sees the new order. With the keyboard, press Space on the grip, use the arrow keys, and press Space again.

2026-10-23-85.title: Paste and drop in the Tracker, posts and minutes
2026-10-23-85.body: Paste a picture or drop files into the Tracker log, the box of a project post, or the meeting minutes. The files join the entry. Nothing saves until you press the save button.

2026-10-23-84.title: A progress bar for every upload
2026-10-23-84.body: Every place that uploads a file now shows how much of it went up: the Tracker, posts, to-do comments, meeting minutes, the Files tab, the project cover and reports. You cannot remove a file while it goes up.

2026-10-23-83.title: File names stay in the chat bubble
2026-10-23-83.body: A long file name now stays inside the chat bubble and ends with three dots. A file that you send with no words shows its name once.

2026-10-23-54.title: Meetings that repeat
2026-10-23-54.body: A meeting can repeat every day, every week or every 2 weeks. Choose Repeat under More when you plan it. When you change or cancel a meeting of a series, you choose this meeting or the later meetings.

2026-10-23-53.title: Your meetings in Google Calendar
2026-10-23-53.body: Connect Google Calendar once in Settings. Madar then puts each of your meetings there and keeps it up to date. Google gets only the title, the time and the place.

2026-10-23-52.title: Minutes after each meeting
2026-10-23-52.body: After a meeting, any attendee writes its minutes on the meeting. A project meeting also gets a line in the Tracker, and its minutes go there.

2026-10-23-51.title: Project chats for the Admin
2026-10-23-51.body: As the Admin, you see the unread count and get pushes of the project chats of your own projects. In other project chats, you see only the messages that name you. Pick All messages in the menu of a chat to see all of it.

2026-10-23-50.title: Fewer pushes
2026-10-23-50.body: A project chat now sends you a push only when a message names you. In the menu of each chat, Notify me sets All messages or Only when I am named. Madar sends no push for a chat that you already read. To reach a person, type @ and pick the name.

2026-10-23-40.title: Search messages
2026-10-23-40.body: Search now finds the messages of your chats and the comments of tasks. Press a result to open the chat at that message. A person card has a Message button, and a project page has a Project chat button.

2026-10-23-25.title: Drop files into a chat
2026-10-23-25.body: Drag files from your computer and drop them on an open chat, or paste a picture into the message box. Each file shows how much of it went up. Nothing goes until you press Send.

2026-10-23-24.title: A calmer chat
2026-10-23-24.body: The chat keeps your place now. It opens at the first new message, under a thin New line. New messages do not move the chat while you read older ones; the round Newest button takes you down. The messages of one person in 5 minutes sit together. A message that names you has a soft color. A chat counts as read only while you look at it. Web addresses are links, and a half-written message stays after you close the tab. On a phone, the title of a task thread can take two lines.

2026-10-23-23.title: Meetings on Home and in a project
2026-10-23-23.body: Home shows your meetings of today. A project shows its next two meetings, and you can plan a meeting there.

2026-10-23-22.title: Meetings
2026-10-23-22.body: Now you can plan a meeting, a client meeting or a site visit, and see it in Tasks. The people you invite get a notice, and a reminder 30 minutes before the start. A meeting with no project is private to its people.

2026-10-23-21.title: Files & Links
2026-10-23-21.body: Now the links of a project are in the Files & Links tab, above the files. You add a file or a link from one button, Add. The About panel does not show the links.

2026-10-23-20.title: The ring on Home
2026-10-23-20.body: The ring next to the date on Home now says what it counts: how many of your tasks for today are done.

2026-10-23-19.title: A restart reminder
2026-10-23-19.body: The planned restart of a paused project is a reminder. On that day the person who paused the project and its leader get a notice: resume the project or set a new date.

2026-10-23-18.title: Tasks with no lead
2026-10-23-18.body: The Workload of the Dashboard has a No lead row. It counts the open tasks that nobody leads, for each week. Press a number to see the tasks.

2026-10-23-17.title: Reasons in task chats
2026-10-23-17.body: The reason for a new date or a reopened task shows as a short line in the task chat, not as a message from a person.

2026-10-23-16.title: Your tasks in the morning email
2026-10-23-16.body: The morning email now lists your open tasks: past due, today and this week, with the project of each task.

2026-10-23-15.title: AI agents set stage dates
2026-10-23-15.body: An AI agent of a project leader can now set the start and end dates of a stage, as the leader does in the Schedule tab.

2026-10-23-14.title: Apply a template to your project
2026-10-23-14.body: Now the leader of a project can apply a template to an ongoing project. Open the project menu and press Apply a template. Madar adds the stages and tasks that the project does not have yet, from today.

2026-10-23-13.title: Who changes a role
2026-10-23-13.body: Now only the Admin changes the role of a person. Management can read a role, but cannot change it.

2026-10-23-1.title: The project list
2026-10-23-1.body: Now the project list shows who works on each project. It shows 3 pictures, then a number such as +2 for the rest.

2026-10-23-2.title: Your profile photo
2026-10-23-2.body: Now a photo with a see-through background shows your glow behind it. Upload the photo again to see the glow.

2026-10-23-3.title: A new calendar
2026-10-23-3.body: Madar has its own calendar on a computer. Turn the mouse wheel to move one month. Press the month name to jump to another month or year. Press Today to come back.

2026-10-23-4.title: Archive a chat
2026-10-23-4.body: Now you can archive a chat. Point at the chat and press the three dots, or swipe the chat on a phone. A new message brings it back. The row Archived is under the search field.

2026-10-23-5.title: Group chats
2026-10-23-5.body: Now you can make a group chat with 2 or more people. Press New message, then New group. Press the number of people under the name of a group to see who is in it. You can send a file or a photo in any chat. A photo in a chat shows as a picture; press it to see it large and download it. In a chat, Arabic text runs from the right and English text from the left, also while you type.

2026-10-23-6.title: Agents read your chats
2026-10-23-6.body: Now your AI agent can read your chats and list the chats that wait for your reply. The AI agent of a colleague in a chat can read the messages of that chat. The agent of a person who is not in the chat cannot read it.

2026-10-23-7.title: Sub-companies
2026-10-23-7.body: Now the Admin can add the sub-companies of the office, each with a logo. A project picks its sub-company, and the logo shows beside the project picture.

2026-10-23-8.title: The project on the map
2026-10-23-8.body: Now you can pin the project on a map in Edit project. Search a place by name or paste a map link. The Dashboard has a Map tab. It shows the street map in Madar colors, with all the pins. The Location of a project is its pin. Madar takes the address from the map. The About panel of a project shows its place on a map. A button on each map opens it full screen.

2026-10-23-9.title: Open space
2026-10-23-9.body: Now Open space shows the office as a mind map of projects, stages and tasks. Open it from the Dashboard.

2026-10-23-10.title: Project templates
2026-10-23-10.body: Now a stage keeps its start and length after you add a task. The Admin can drag the stages of a project template, copy a template, and see its timeline. Each task and stage has a Waits for picker. The Admin can also send an update to the projects made from a template.

2026-10-23-11.title: Roles and rights
2026-10-23-11.body: Now the Admin can make a custom role and choose its rights.

2026-10-23-12.title: The office report
2026-10-23-12.body: Now a person with the report right can ask an AI agent for the full office report.

2026-10-23-68.title: Rights in sections
2026-10-23-68.body: The rights of a role now sit in seven sections, and each section has an All switch. Turn on only the parts of the Admin work that a role needs.
